decision: Original repeated exports and the preceding v0.20 game adapter agree. The initial investigation was expanded with all authored timing skills, live break-policy and bonus changes, and per-step input observations. A mistaken test setup that applied a more modifier beneath a global override was corrected to a live skill override before acceptance; the exporter independently asserts the expected fizzle clock.
scope: Concentration duration/progress/break decisions, fizzle cooldown quote and castPress timing policy. Target authority/geometry, input authority, shared admission, interruption cleanup and delivery remain explicit host responsibilities.
observations: Original concentration can deliver on a focused update after caster death; the host owns death cleanup.
A concentration skill without a targeting spec can pay before its later no-quarry refusal.
A timing support changed midbar supplies its live bonus but does not replace the already stored cast mode.
Standalone phases are rehydrated original states; continuous original and installed-game courses are separate checks.
